verses.1: On the third day of the month, when the children of Israel left Egypt from that land, they came out of the Sea of China.
verses.2: They traveled from Rephidim, and they came out of the desert of Sinai. They camped in the desert, and Israel lay down there, facing the mountain.
verses.3: And Moses went up to God and cried out to Him from the mountain. He said, “Say this to the house of Jacob and to all the children of Israel.”
verses.4: Have you seen what I have done to the Egyptians? I will carry you on my wings and bring you to Me.
verses.5: And now, if you will listen to my voice and keep my covenant, then you will be my chosen people among all the nations. For I own all this land.
verses.6: And you shall be my queens over the priests and the holy people. These are the words that you shall speak to the children of Israel.
verses.7: And Moses came and called out to the elders of the people. He placed before them all these words that Jehovah had commanded him.
verses.8: And all the people answered together. They said, “All that the LORD has spoken will be done.” Then Moses reported the words of the people to the LORD.
verses.9: And the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will come to you in the cloud. When the people hear My words, they will believe in Me forever.” Then Moses reported the people’s words to the LORD.
verses.10: And the LORD said to Moses, “Go and sanctify them today, and tomorrow. Then they shall put on their robes.”
verses.11: And they were prepared for the third day. On the third day, Jehovah will descend before the eyes of all the people, on Mount Sinai.
verses.12: And you shall bind the people around it, saying, “Keep up the hill as a sacred place. Anyone who touches it will die.”
verses.13: No hand shall touch it, whether it be a sheep or a man. No one will live in its presence. They will all be carried up into the mountains.
verses.14: And Moses descended from the mountain to the people. He sanctified the people, and they put on their clothes.
verses.15: And he said to the people, “Let them stay here for three days. Do not go near any woman.”
verses.16: And on the third day, in the morning, there was thunder and lightning, and dark clouds over the mountain. There was also a loud roar from the thunder. All the people who were in the camp were terrified.
verses.17: Moses led the people out from the camp to worship God. They stood at the foot of the mountain.
verses.18: And Mount Sinai was completely covered in smoke because of the fire that Jehovah sent down upon it. The smoke rose up from the mountain, and it destroyed everything on that mountain.
verses.19: And the voice of the trumpet would sound loudly and clearly. Moses would speak, and God would respond to him with that sound.
verses.20: And Jehovah descended onto Mount Sinai. He called out to Moses from the top of the mountain. Then Moses ascended up the mountain.
verses.21: And the LORD said to Moses, “Let the people go down from the mountain, so that they may not die upon seeing it and fall away from me.”
verses.22: And also, the priests who approach Jehovah will be sanctified, so that Jehovah may not break them.
verses.23: And Moses said to Jehovah, “The people cannot climb up the Mount Sinai. For You have commanded us to sanctify the mountain and make it holy.”
verses.24: And the LORD said to him, “Go up, you and Aaron, along with the priests and the people. Do not let them destroy the altar before Jehovah, or else it will be destroyed.”
verses.25: And Moses went down to the people and said to them:
